sections.title: Review findings
sections.sql: select rule,action from study_attention where id=$1

sections.title: Review notes
sections.sql: select body,actor,created_at from notes where study_id=$1

sections.title: Source and freshness
sections.note: Internal research record, not approved for disclosure. A stale result must be rerun.

sections.title: Specification
sections.sql: select specification from analysis_runs where id=$1

sections.title: Saved estimates
sections.sql: select x->>'group' as segment,x->>'category' as category,x->>'base' as unweighted_base,x->>'weighted_base' as weighted_base,x->>'effective_base' as effective_base,x->>'percent' as percent,x->>'mean' as mean,x->>'status' as status from analysis_runs a cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(a.result) x where a.id=$1
